<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="/jrswab/axe/blob/master/banner.png"><img src="/jrswab/axe/raw/master/banner.png" alt="axe banner" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto">A CLI tool for managing and running LLM-powered agents.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Why Axe?</h2><a id="user-content-why-axe" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Why Axe?" href="#why-axe"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Most AI tooling assumes you want a chatbot. A long-running session with a massive context window doing everything at once. But that's not how good software works. Good software is small, focused, and composable.</p>
<p dir="auto">Axe treats LLM agents the same way Unix treats programs. Each agent does one thing well. You define it in a TOML file, give it a focused skill, and run it from the command line. Pipe data in, get results out. Chain agents together. Trigger them from cron, git hooks, or CI. Whatever you already use. No daemon, no GUI, no framework to buy into. Just a binary and your configs.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Overview</h2><a id="user-content-overview" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Overview" href="#overview"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Axe orchestrates LLM-powered agents defined via TOML configuration files. Each agent has its own system prompt, model selection, skill files, context files, working directory, persistent memory, and the ability to delegate to sub-agents.</p>
<p dir="auto">Axe is the executor, not the scheduler. It is designed to be composed with standard Unix tools — cron, git hooks, pipes, file watchers — rather than reinventing scheduling or workflow orchestration.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h2><a id="user-content-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Multi-provider support</strong> — Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama (local models), OpenCode, and AWS Bedrock</li>
<li><strong>TOML-based agent configuration</strong> — declarative, version-controllable agent definitions</li>
<li><strong>Sub-agent delegation</strong> — agents can call other agents via LLM tool use, with depth limiting and parallel execution</li>
<li><strong>Persistent memory</strong> — timestamped markdown logs that carry context across runs</li>
<li><strong>Memory garbage collection</strong> — LLM-assisted pattern analysis and trimming</li>
<li><strong>Skill system</strong> — reusable instruction sets that can be shared across agents</li>
<li><strong>Stdin piping</strong> — pipe any output directly into an agent (<code>git diff | axe run reviewer</code>)</li>
<li><strong>Local agent directories</strong> — auto-discovers agents from <code><cwd>/axe/agents/</code> before the global config, or use <code>--agents-dir</code> to point anywhere</li>
<li><strong>Dry-run mode</strong> — inspect resolved context without calling the LLM</li>
<li><strong>JSON output</strong> — structured output with metadata for scripting</li>
<li><strong>Built-in tools</strong> — file operations (read, write, edit, list) sandboxed to working directory; shell command execution; URL fetching; web search</li>
<li><strong>Output allowlist</strong> — restrict <code>url_fetch</code> and <code>web_search</code> to specific hostnames; private/reserved IPs are always blocked (SSRF protection)</li>
<li><strong>Token budgets</strong> — cap cumulative token usage per agent run via <code>[budget]</code> config or <code>--max-tokens</code> flag</li>
<li><strong>MCP tool support</strong> — connect to external MCP servers for additional tools via SSE or streamable-HTTP transport</li>
<li><strong>Configurable retry</strong> — exponential, linear, or fixed backoff for transient provider errors (429, 5xx, timeouts)</li>
<li><strong>Minimal dependencies</strong> — four direct dependencies (cobra, toml, mcp-go-sdk, x/net); all LLM calls use the standard library</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Installation</h2><a id="user-content-installation" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Installation" href="#installation"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Requires Go 1.25+.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Pre-built binaries</strong> (no Go required) are available for Linux, macOS, and Windows on the <a href="https://github.com/jrswab/axe/releases/latest">GitHub Releases page</a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">Install via Go:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="go install github.com/jrswab/axe@latest"><pre>go install github.com/jrswab/axe@latest</pre></div>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">If this fails with <code>invalid go version</code>, your Go toolchain is older than 1.25. Upgrade from <a href="https://go.dev/dl/" rel="nofollow">go.dev/dl</a> or download a pre-built binary instead.</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">Or build from source:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="git clone https://github.com/jrswab/axe.git
cd axe
go build ."><pre>git clone https://github.com/jrswab/axe.git
<span class="pl-c1">cd</span> axe
go build <span class="pl-c1">.</span></pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Quick Start</h2><a id="user-content-quick-start" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Quick Start" href="#quick-start"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Initialize the configuration directory:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="axe config init"><pre>axe config init</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">This creates the directory structure at <code>$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/axe/</code> with a sample skill and a default <code>config.toml</code> for provider credentials.</p>
<p dir="auto">Scaffold a new agent:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="axe agents init my-agent"><pre>axe agents init my-agent</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Edit its configuration:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="axe agents edit my-agent"><pre>axe agents edit my-agent</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Run the agent:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="axe run my-agent"><pre>axe run my-agent</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Pipe input from other tools:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="git diff --cached | axe run pr-reviewer
cat error.log | axe run log-analyzer"><pre>git diff --cached <span class="pl-k">|</span> axe run pr-reviewer
cat error.log <span class="pl-k">|</span> axe run log-analyzer</pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Examples</h2><a id="user-content-examples" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Examples" href="#examples"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The <a href="/jrswab/axe/blob/master/examples"><code>examples/</code></a> directory contains ready-to-run agents you can copy into your config and use immediately. Includes a code reviewer, commit message generator, and text summarizer — each with a focused SKILL.md.</p>

<p dir="auto">See <a href="/jrswab/axe/blob/master/examples/README.md"><code>examples/README.md</code></a> for full setup instructions.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Docker</h2><a id="user-content-docker" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Docker" href="#docker"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Axe provides a Docker image for running agents in an isolated, hardened container.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Build the Image</h3><a id="user-content-build-the-image" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Build the Image" href="#build-the-image"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker build -t axe ."><pre>docker build -t axe <span class="pl-c1">.</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Multi-architecture builds (linux/amd64, linux/arm64) are supported via buildx:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t axe:latest ."><pre>docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t axe:latest <span class="pl-c1">.</span></pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Run an Agent</h3><a id="user-content-run-an-agent" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Run an Agent" href="#run-an-agent"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Mount your config directory and pass API keys as environment variables:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run --rm \
  -v ./my-config:/home/axe/.config/axe \
  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY \
  axe run my-agent"><pre>docker run --rm \
  -v ./my-config:/home/axe/.config/axe \
  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY \
  axe run my-agent</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Pipe stdin with the <code>-i</code> flag:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="git diff | docker run --rm -i \
  -v ./my-config:/home/axe/.config/axe \
  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY \
  axe run pr-reviewer"><pre>git diff <span class="pl-k">|</span> docker run --rm -i \
  -v ./my-config:/home/axe/.config/axe \
  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY \
  axe run pr-reviewer</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Without a config volume mounted, axe exits with code 2 (config error) because no agent TOML files exist.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Running a Single Agent</h3><a id="user-content-running-a-single-agent" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Running a Single Agent" href="#running-a-single-agent"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The examples above mount the entire config directory. If you only need to run one agent with one skill, mount just those files to their expected XDG paths inside the container. No <code>config.toml</code> is needed when API keys are passed via environment variables.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run --rm -i \
  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY \
  -v ./agents/reviewer.toml:/home/axe/.config/axe/agents/reviewer.toml:ro \
  -v ./skills/code-review/:/home/axe/.config/axe/skills/code-review/:ro \
  axe run reviewer"><pre>docker run --rm -i \
  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY \
  -v ./agents/reviewer.toml:/home/axe/.config/axe/agents/reviewer.toml:ro \
  -v ./skills/code-review/:/home/axe/.config/axe/skills/code-review/:ro \
  axe run reviewer</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">The agent's <code>skill</code> field resolves automatically against the XDG config path inside the container, so no <code>--skill</code> flag is needed.</p>
<p dir="auto">To use a <strong>different skill</strong> than the one declared in the agent's TOML, use the <code>--skill</code> flag to override it. In this case you only mount the replacement skill — the original skill declared in the TOML is ignored entirely:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run --rm -i \
  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY \
  -v ./agents/reviewer.toml:/home/axe/.config/axe/agents/reviewer.toml:ro \
  -v ./alt-review.md:/home/axe/alt-review.md:ro \
  axe run reviewer --skill /home/axe/alt-review.md"><pre>docker run --rm -i \
  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY \
  -v ./agents/reviewer.toml:/home/axe/.config/axe/agents/reviewer.toml:ro \
  -v ./alt-review.md:/home/axe/alt-review.md:ro \
  axe run reviewer --skill /home/axe/alt-review.md</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">If the agent declares <code>sub_agents</code>, all referenced agent TOMLs and their skills must also be mounted.</p>

<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run --rm \
  -v ./my-config:/home/axe/.config/axe \
  -v axe-data:/home/axe/.local/share/axe \
  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY \
  axe run my-agent"><pre>docker run --rm \
  -v ./my-config:/home/axe/.config/axe \
  -v axe-data:/home/axe/.local/share/axe \
